effect: Constitutional-amendment laws now use the country's own amendment rule. The vote threshold in rBB was the context's amendmentPct, then a constitution field nothing sets, then 60%. Only reforms passed a value, so religion laws needed 60% everywhere: too little where the constitution requires two thirds, too much where it is flexible. The fallback is now the game's own rule table (oIB: flexible 50%, qualified two thirds, otherwise 60%), so the forecast, the vote and the AI's check all read the same figure, and reforms are unchanged. Not changed: referendum countries still have no referendum for these laws; that is a separate choice. Expected effect: religion and freedom-of-worship laws become harder to pass under two-thirds constitutions and easier under flexible ones. Day 0 unchanged. No new state. (Minified names in this text are those of build 26403824; the patch's find text has the current ones.)
